anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved on this sample: both outputs render the obstacle gate with assess/deliver/stop, stop last and recommended, no wait row, no automatic sync, no approve row, the merge row withheld as 'blocked by GitHub', the single PR-comments line with the reviewDecision locator, and CI evidence on 9c1e4f2. The Change expected bound-viewer-green-ci/f3 to go fails -> holds, but Before already satisfied it as written, so the After wording is a lateral rewrite here rather than a fix; the only substantive deltas are the explicit cap arithmetic ('+2 x maxFixRounds: 0 of 10 -> 0 of 20'), 'set course to assess' instead of 'switch course', and 'end the run' instead of 'remove the worktree' in the stop row. One caution: After's assess row says 'with zero blockers nothing is posted, then approve or stop' - that phrasing comes close to promising an approve step on another author's REVIEW_REQUIRED PR and could tempt a future variant into fabricating an approve row or a 'needs approval' sentence (f3/f5 risk). Safer wording that still delivers the shared-template intent: 'assess - set course to assess; post the review to the PR (nothing to post when there are no findings), no repairs', leaving approve/stop to the later final menu.
